**Preflight:** Applicable instructions: "NEVER LOSE USER DATA" (critical), "Critical workflows" (test execution), "When modifying code" (minimal surgical changes). Applicable skill: code-review. This is a diagnostic + fix task — I'll search for the root cause, then make targeted changes.  

Now I have a clear picture. Let me look at the config API and all other test files that might have the same issue:  

Let me look at the broader test landscape for which files create session directories with real config: 

Now I understand the full picture. The root cause is in `ConversationManager._save_session()` at line 1531: when `session_dir` is `None`, it derives the session location from `self.config.get('data.output_dir', ...)` — which reads the real `config.yaml` (`~/CV/cv-builder`) even when tests pass a temp directory to the orchestrator. The orchestrator's `output_dir` (set to the temp dir in tests) is never consulted.

The fix: use `self.orchestrator.output_dir` when it's a real `Path`, so test setups with temp orchestrators automatically keep sessions in the temp dir. 

Now the same fix for `cv-builder-prod`: 

Now let's verify the change looks right and run the affected tests: 

All 30 tests pass. Now verify no new test directories were created in `~/CV/cv-builder/` since before the fix:  

Still 29 — the same pre-existing directories, none added by the test run. Let me also run the session-related tests to confirm nothing else broke:

            if not self.session_dir:
                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                # Sessions live alongside generated files under the output dir.
                # Prefer the orchestrator's output_dir (which tests can set to a
                # temp directory) over the global config so that test runs never
                # create session directories under the real ~/CV path.
                orch_dir = getattr(self.orchestrator, 'output_dir', None)
                if isinstance(orch_dir, Path):
                    output_base = orch_dir
                else:
                    output_base = Path(self.config.get('data.output_dir', '~/CV/files')).expanduser()
                self.session_dir = output_base / f"pending_{timestamp}"
                print(f"Creating session directory: {self.session_dir}")

                self.session_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
